title: Normalized family data for adic realization isomorphisms
statement: Package the definitions `GeometricSpace`, `SpaceData`, `integralRealizationAgreement`, `FamilyCore`, and `Family` from the normalized adic realization construction.  A geometric space is a separated, quasi-compact, finite-type scheme over the fixed geometric point.  SpaceData contains the native realization, its section-module equivalence, exactness, essential image, tensor and finite-normalization data, and Hom laws.  FamilyCore contains this data for every space, ring and integral reindexing data for every scheme isomorphism, module identity and composition, common-stage comparison and source identity, tensor reindexing, and the specified unit.  Family adds pointwise module identity and composition normalization, integral realization agreement on every finite stage, source identity, identity and composition equations, tensor and coefficient-unit compatibility, and the evaluation-transpose Hom compatibility.  These are definition packages, with no existence assertion, and use the fixed coefficient and reindexing notions of [def-sf-native-adic-realization-data], [def-sf-native-adic-finite-normalization], [def-sf-native-adic-reindexing-data], [def-sf-native-adic-tensor-reindexing], and [def-weil-finite-field-fiber].
